Subject: Customer vouch intro for EmberHealth — HIPAA + SLA questions

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — really excited about EmberHealth's pilot plans. As you requested, we'd like to arrange a quick customer vouch call so your procurement and security teams can hear from a Redwood customer running HIPAA workloads in production. To make that call high signal, can you confirm the two most important areas you'd like the reference to cover? From our notes you mentioned:

- 99th-percentile response latency for interactive telehealth sessions (under 150ms preferred)
- SOC2 + HIPAA operational controls and audit evidence cadence
- Experience with routing/fallbacks during regional capacity spikes
- Any on-prem or VPC deployment considerations for EHR integrations

If that's correct, we'll propose a 30-minute peer call and can surface a customer who has similar scale and the same payer/integration constraints. I attached a short Ember-focused one-pager that summarizes what we typically highlight for HIPAA customers.

Proposed slots (PT): Wed 6/16 10:00–11:30, Thu 6/17 09:00–12:00. If none of those work, share a couple times and we'll coordinate.

Also happy to sign your standard mutual NDA before the call if procurement prefers.

Thanks — Jonas

We'd prefer a US-based customer (East coast ideally) and someone who recently completed a contract with explicit SLAs. NDAs are standard for our legal team — I can share ours if that makes things smoother.

Availability: Thu 6/17 09:30–10:30 ET (which I think is 6:30–7:30 PT) would work for procurement + security. If you can propose a single candidate who can cover both ops and architecture, even better.

Two quick candidates that fit your ask and can speak to SLA clauses, evidence cadence, and deployment topology:

2) Coya Clinics — Ava Morales (Head of Platform). Coya is a regional clinic network that uses Redwood for real-time triage and has a recent contract addendum covering latency SLAs and audit-process integration with their HIE. They can speak to deployment tradeoffs at lower latency budgets.

We can arrange a single panel call with one of the two + one of our engineers who can speak to kernel/latency optimization (KV caching, batching profile, and quantization choices) if you'd like both product + customer perspective.

Proposed slot matches your window: Thu 6/17 09:30 ET — does that work if we schedule 30 minutes? I'll attach Brightline's case brief and a short SLA excerpt for reference.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwoodinference.com/deal/EMBER-2027-042
Rachel — can you send the intro and attach the briefs? Vivek, any objections to Brightline covering the SLA talk?
